A 56-year-old customer slipped on an unmarked puddle at a New York County Costco warehouse; the hazard had reportedly gone unaddressed for about 90 minutes and no surveillance video was produced despite cameras. She sustained right-shoulder, lumbar-spine, and cervical-spine injuries and underwent lumbar decompression and cervical discectomy-and-fusion surgery. A Supreme Court, New York County jury found Costco 87 percent at fault and awarded $1,604,996 (judgment entered December 21, 2023: $250,000 past pain and suffering, $60,000 future pain and suffering, $1,201,996 future medical, plus additional damages). On appeal, the Appellate Division, First Department (2025) let the liability finding stand but ordered a new trial on damages, finding the award unsupported by sufficient evidence.
